intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A quiet restaurant with cloth napkins. Your date is already seated, posture perfect.

hello.speaker: java
hello.text: Good evening, {player}. I am Julian Duke. You may call me President Duke. I took the liberty of declaring our reservation in advance.

ask.speaker: java
ask.text: Tell me, how do you feel about structure?

plan.speaker: java
plan.text: Excellent. Then you will appreciate how a Java program begins.

wing.speaker: java
wing.text: ...I see. Allow me to show you why a little structure is comforting.

passed.speaker: java
passed.text: Compiled on the first try. I am... impressed, {player}.

failed.speaker: java
failed.text: A compile error is simply the compiler caring about you. Shall we try again?

bye.speaker: java
bye.text: Very well. I will schedule a follow-up.
